import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/szemeredi-vu.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/szemeredi-vu.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
s=r.stdout;print(s[:17500]);print('SECTION LOCATIONS');print('\n'.join(f'{i} {l}' for i,l in enumerate(s.splitlines()) if '6.' in l or 'Corollary 1.4' in l))
